Meaning of gleam in English

gleamnoun
A gleam of light is a small, bright light that shines briefly:
the gleam of a lighthouse across the bay
a faint gleam in the dark
Synonyms glint flash
a brief sign of a quality or emotion, seen in someone's eyes:
There was a hint of mischief in her eyes.
More examples

The old car still had a polished shine.
